name: SonarQube Quality Hub
description: A modern read-only SonarQube workspace: projects, scan history, issue filtering, Markdown export and quality insights from PostgreSQL.
releaseNotes: 0.1.10 fixes Markdown export on DBX: the UI now calls host.saveFile with the required {fileName, contentType} metadata plus a UTF-8 base64 payload, so the save dialog opens instead of failing with host.saveFile requires transferred binary data or dataBase64; a failed or missing host save falls back to the built-in Markdown preview. 0.1.9 had turned the top scan switcher and both scan comparison fields into searchable, 20-row single-select popovers; adds local issue snapshots with hasSnapshot guards, four-card comparison results, compact build-number labels, and a 390px mobile layout fix. The workspace remains read-only against SonarQube PostgreSQL, with project switching, scan history, rule and directory multi-select filters, Markdown issue export and global quality insights.
